Mode ids: PlanetaryBattles=Galactic Assault, Mode1=Supremacy, Blast=Blast, Mode9=CO-OP (attack), ModeDefend=CO-OP (defend). AJAN KLOSS IS 'PAINTBALL' IN THE GAME FILES (S9/Paintball/Levels/MP/Paintball_01/Paintball_01) — the user found this and live-tested it 2026-09-12: KYBER loaded it as Mode1 (Supremacy) and played through cleanly (real capture: bundle streams for Paintball_01/Content/Lobby/Lighting/Collision/Day, then 'Server level loaded', then the Mode1 bundle). No Blast entry for Paintball exists anywhere in the rotation export, though (checked every mode) — so ajankloss_supremacy uses trigger 'any' rather than 'fleet', the same map covers both the fleet-defended and garrison-only case, mirroring how GCW's Scarif handles its own missing-Blast gap (scarif_coop uses trigger 'garrison' instead of forcing a nonexistent Blast) rather than the two-Takodana-stand-in-entries this file used before Ajan Kloss's real map was found. The two dedicated co-op ship-interior maps (S9_3/COOP_NT_MC85, S9_3/COOP_NT_FOSD) ARE real and verified, confirmed working for both Mode9 and ModeDefend in the export — they were previously tried as a GCW space-lane stand-in and removed 2026-09-10 for loading the wrong factions (First Order/Resistance) in a Galactic Civil War context; here, that pairing is exactly correct. Unlike Clone Wars' Kamino_03/Geonosis_02 (one dual-purpose level file serving both a planet's Supremacy match AND its lane co-op), these are dedicated, single-purpose co-op levels — no ground-phase-to-capital-ship transition exists for this campaign at all, and none is needed. team_one_faction is the LIGHT-SIDE faction on the sequel ship co-ops: Team 1 is always the light side (Resistance), Team 2 the dark side (First Order), regardless of which side the human plays. All four sequel co-op entries use 'resistance'; the human is pinned by faction side (Resistance -> 1, First Order -> 2). 2026-10-30 live: First Order attacking or defending must be Team 2, not Team 1. Planet battles use the same light-side convention.
_selection: KyberBridge.choose_map_key: a HOME world (Starkiller Base, Crait) is always Galactic Assault. Otherwise trigger 'fleet' when a fleet defends (-> Supremacy, or the fleet-agnostic Ajan Kloss entry). Garrison-only is now a HELD_BY split, 2026-09-12 (previously unconditional Blast, the user's own initial simplification — since refined): a Resistance-held garrison plays CO-OP (Mode9, the planet's own level — Jakku_02 / Takodana_02 / Paintball_01 — same trick Clone Wars' felucia_coop already uses, not a dedicated ship interior), a First Order-held one plays Blast (Jakku/Takodana) or Supremacy (Ajan Kloss, which has no real Blast at all). Implemented as one extra entry per planet (`<planet>_coop`, trigger 'garrison' + held_by 'resistance', `_score_map_entry` scores held_by matches +1 over an unscoped trigger match, so it only outranks the Blast/'any' fallback when Resistance actually holds it) rather than rewriting the existing Blast/'any' entries, which stay exactly as they were for every other case. A space lane is a capital-ship boarding co-op, same shape as Clone Wars: the MAP is the defender's ship (defender_faction) and the coop_role is 'attack' (Mode9) when player_faction == request.attacker, 'defend' (ModeDefend) otherwise.
